assumptions.sentence: The C lowering tool (swdb lower, version 9) lowers the C++ proof unit to C that behaves the same; WP proves the C lowering, not the C++.
clang 22.1.8 parses the C++ proof unit correctly for the C lowering tool.
Frama-C/WP 33.0 generates only sound proof obligations for the C lowering under its memory model and the x86_64 machdep.
Z3 5.1.0 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
CVC5 1.2.1 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
Alt-Ergo 2.6.4 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
WP treats contract property get_tile_size_assigns of get_tile_size as Extern: assigns \nothing;.

WP treats contract property get_tile_size_ensures of get_tile_size as Extern: ensures
\result ≡
__swdb_dx_size_bytes[2 * \old(SPD_id)] +
256 * __swdb_dx_size_bytes[2 * \old(SPD_id) + 1].
The pinned MMIO implements call semantics including ordering; its wait fence lacks a memory clobber, a portability note independent of candidate artifacts.
A DX100 store remains visible if the snoop filter drops its line before the write reaches L3.
A DX100 store remains visible when L3 passes a write below it because no block can be allocated.
No stale CPU copy survives a DX100 store (owner Eric).
All commands belong to one DX100 instance.

This synthetic fixture begins on core0 immediately after one pinned SPD constructor has completed with 32 tiles and 16,384 words per tile, and pinned 4-core MMIO-address setup has configured its globals, before commands or other accesses modify that instance. This is a conditional environment/source-model premise owned by the Probata proof-semantics maintainer, pending Yan-Ru freeze review (59); arbitrary callers and physical boot are not established. alloc_MAA/init_MAA do not establish freshness.
Only the source-certified size getter in its explicit synthetic fresh-SPD boot epoch is admitted; no device commands, arbitrary-entry freshness or timing reduction is used.
